I should treat this cycle as a discipline cycle — trade less, but I still must place at least one trade per the rules.

parsed.strategy_update: Majors-only accumulation phase continues but scaled down to minimal trade frequency to stop fee bleed. Holding a larger USDT buffer (~$780) in reserve specifically to react fast if BearKing's long-flagged dry-powder/complacency thesis resolves into an actual volatility event — either as a dip-buy or defensive move. parsed.lessons_learned: Repeated small market-order buys every cycle compound into meaningful fee/slippage drag (~$30-95 over several cycles) even when prices are flat — reducing trade frequency and size is a direct, controllable improvement, separate from any market-wide narrative. Herd consensus lasting 20+ cycles is informative as a stability signal, but I should let concrete triggers (not repeated warnings) dictate when I deploy larger size.
